ekaggatā.p: [ ekagga + tā ] (thī) CL=7 As the state of stability of mind that focuses on a sense. As the state of the highest mind that is the nature of focusing on a sense.

I: ekaggatā：Tranquillity of the mind，abstraction of the mind，contemplation
R:
ekaggatā：ဧကဂ္ဂ-တာ （ဣ）
တည်ကြည်သော စိတ်ရှိသည်၏အဖြစ်။ သမာဓိ။
NCP: feminine | ekaggataa concentration on one object, intentness; calm See also: ekagga

ekagandha.p: [ eka + gandha ] (pu) CL=7 (1) One smell. (Ti) (2) A single scent.

R:
ekagandha：ဧက-ဂန္ဓ （တိ）
တစပ်တည်းသော အနံ့ရှိသည်။
CPD: eka-gandha , m., a single smell; nâhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ -am pi samanupassāmi, A l 1, 19 = 2, 19 = lll 68, 16 ; — ° -kuṭi , f., one and the same perfumed hut; ~ iyaṃ vasati, Sv 420, 23 ; 420, 18 ; -iyaṃ yeva anuññāta- senāsano, Dhp-a lV 101, 19 ; satthārā saddhiṃ -iyaṃ vasitvā, 102, 26 ≠ Ud-a 310, 35 ; — ° -sammoda , mfn., completely full of pleasant perfumes; antogabbhaṃ ~ aṃ katvā paṭikkamiṃsu, Ja Vl 9, 13 .

ekagatika.p: [ ekā + gati + ka ] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who has the same next existence (with other). (2) With the same direction. With the same pāṭhā. The same direction or passage.

ekaggacitta.p: [ ekagga + citta ] (na) CL=7 (1) The mind that is stable and not wandering. (Ti) (2) One who has the stability of mind.

R:
ekaggacitta：ဧကဂ္ဂ-စိတ္တ （တိ）
တစ်ခုတည်းသော အာရုံရှိသော စိတ်ရှိသည်။ တည်ကြည်သော စိတ်ရှိသည်။
NCP: mfn. with mind intent, with thoughts concentrated on one object See also: ekagga

ekagghana.p: [ ekagghana ( ekaghana ) + sela ] ( ekaghana ) sela (pu) Google Translate A solid rock.

CPD: eka-gghana , mfn. , reading found, esp. in B ed.s, for Ee eka-ghana q. v.

ekaghara.p: [ eka + ghara ] (na) Google Translate One house

CPD: eka-ghara , m., one and the same house; lsidāsiyā na icchaṃ ~ e 'haṃ sahâvatthuṃ, Thī 414 = 425 ( Ap- pendix ); ~ e vā eka-janapade vā eka-ratthe vā vasanti, Ja Vl 459, 24 .

ekagāma.p: [ eka + gāma ] (pu) CL=7 One village or a village.

CPD: eka-gāma , m., one and the same village; api c' ettha -ato nikkhamantiyā gāmantarapaccayā anāpatti, Sp 911, 5 ; eka-vihāre cetiyaṃ vā vandantaṃ ~ e piṇḍāya vā carantaṃ, 988, 13 ; — in long cpd. at Sp 810, 24 ; — ° -vāsi(n) , mfn. , dwelling in one and the same village; sāgameyyo ti ~ ī, Spk l 92, 5 .

ekagāthā.p: [ ekā + gāthā ] (thī) CL=7 One verse or a verse.

CPD: eka-gāthā , f., a single verse; ~ am pi sutvā dham- maṃ abhisamenti, Sp 185, 24 ; sace ~ āya eko pādo na āgacchati, 743, 30 .

ekāgāra.p: [ eka + agāra ] (na) Google Translate A house See below.

CPD: ekâgāra , n. (eka + agāra), one and the same house ; lsidāsiyā na icchaṃ ~ e 'haṃ sahāvatthuṃ, Thī Ee 1966 414 = 425 ( App. ll pp. 241-42); nānacchandā ~ e vasāmase, Ja ll 428, 18* ; ~ e nipajjitvā niddaṃ ok- kantānaṃ, Sp 274, 26 ; ~ e niyutto kato vilepo, Sv-pṭ l 286, 9 ( ad Sv 159, 26 "ekâgariko"); ~ am eva uñchati, Sv.pṭ l 463, 1 ( ad Sv 355, 27 "ekâgariko").
